sample_labels: Common saying: 钱不是万能的 (Money is not omnipotent)
钱不是万能的 (Qián bú shì wànnéng de) - Money is not omnipotent

“钱不是万能的”，这句话的意思是钱虽然很重要，但是钱不能解决所有的问题。 (“Qián bú shì wànnéng de”, zhè jù huà de yìsi shì qián suīrán hěn zhòngyào, dànshì qián bù néng jiějué suǒyǒu de wèntí.) - “钱不是万能的” means that although money is very important, it cannot solve all problems.

这句话告诉我们对待金钱要有正确的认识，虽然生活中处处需要钱，但是有钱也不一定能办成所有的事情。 (Zhè jù huà gàosu wǒmen duìdài jīnqián yào yǒu zhèngquè de rènshi, suīrán shēnghuó zhōng chùchù xūyào qián, dànshì yǒu qián yě bù yídìng néng bàn chéng suǒyǒu de shìqing.) - This saying tells us to have a correct attitude towards money: although we need money everywhere in life, having money does not necessarily mean everything can be accomplished.
万能 (wànnéng) - omnipotent, all-powerful

Pronunciation: Intonation of an Alternative Question
你喜欢吃米饭还是吃面条？ (Nǐ xǐhuan chī mǐfàn háishi chī miàntiáo?) - Do you like to eat rice or noodles? (alternative question, rising then falling intonation)
你想今天去还是明天去？ (Nǐ xiǎng jīntiān qù háishi míngtiān qù?) - Do you want to go today or tomorrow? (alternative question, rising then falling intonation)
你去学校是开车还是坐车？ (Nǐ qù xuéxiào shì kāi chē háishi zuò chē?) - Do you go to school by driving or by taking a bus/car? (alternative question, rising then falling intonation)
